title: Invited: IEEE DATC RDF-2025: Enabling an EDA Research Ecosystem
problem: EDA research lacks standardized open-source infrastructures and benchmarking mechanisms that support academic reproducibility and commercial tool vendor collaboration.
motivation: Establishing accessible EDA research infrastructure and enabling industry-academia partnerships accelerates innovation in design automation.
method: IEEE CEDA DATC establishes: (1) a GitHub resource with OpenROAD-based research environment, (2) permission mechanisms and benchmarking for commercial P&R tools with vendor collaboration, and (3) ML EDA Commons initiative for machine learning in EDA.
key_novelty: First formal permission mechanism and public benchmarking results for commercial EDA tools published with vendor permission.
contributions: Accessible GitHub resource providing OpenROAD and OpenROAD-flow-scripts-based research environment
First-ever permission mechanism for commercial EDA tool benchmarking with published results
ML EDA Commons initiative supporting ML-driven EDA research
Community infrastructure supporting reproducible EDA research and open culture development
limitations: Infrastructure paper focused on ecosystem building rather than specific algorithmic or hardware innovations.
